Time

Playing runs at about 500 times real speed. Drag the sky to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom.

Search

Stars, planets, the Moon, the space station and deep sky objects. Pick one and the view glides to it; a gold arrow leads your eye when it sits outside the frame.

Showcase

A slow tour of tonight's showpieces, each with one quiet line. Made for the big screen.

Point at the sky

On a phone or tablet, hold it up and the view follows where you point. On a screen without a compass this does nothing, and dragging always works.

View

Sound & Music

Off by default, always. The soundscapes are made in the page, so they work with no connection.
